guide.description: Play seven notes with one hand. 1–5 = Do/Re/Mi/Fa/Sol, thumb + pinky = La, OK = Si. Close your hand or move it away to rest.

controls.action: Start or stop the camera and sound. Show one whole hand, with space between extended fingers.
Adjust loudness. Choose your speaker or headphones in the shared Menu.
Choose Soft, Bell, Pluck or Retro. Turn E2, press it for the next sound, or open the Tone menu. Your choice is saved.
Turn the camera image upright in 90 degree steps before playing.
Flip the upright preview left to right. Both hands use the same note mapping.
Play Do/Re/Mi/Fa/Sol. For Re use index + middle; for Mi use index + middle + ring.
Extend only thumb and pinky; fold the other three fingers.
Touch thumb and index fingertips; extend middle, ring and pinky. This takes priority over three-finger counting.
Make a fist or move the hand away. Switching a note smoothly changes pitch; a rest starts a fresh attack.
Tap a note to hear a short preview. Preview uses no camera and does not test hand recognition.
